ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is shown at letter G?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a life history cycle diagram of a potato disease, with multiple stages marked by capital letters. The letter G is located at the lower right of the figure, near a curved arrow that goes downward from the soil/spore-related area and turns toward the potato plant and underground tubers at the bottom. Reasoning: This position indicates the stage in which the pathogen's zoospores move from the soil and infect potato tubers, so G represents “Zoospores infect tubers”.
